interaction: Answer three questions (age, face in the water, can they swim 5 m) and the matching pool lane lights up with splash rings while its swimmer does laps, and the deck card shows the level, class times and an enrol shortcut; hovering or tabbing to any lane sends its swimmer along the black line.
notes: Question 3 adds a '25 m or more' answer so the Squad lane can be reached. Level stickers explain progression but are not interactive collectibles. Enrolment ends in an on-page DEMO state and toast; nothing is sent.
